cues.text: Every token safety tool reads the contract and infers.
Sidik doesn't infer. It buys the token, sells it, and tries to rug it.
On a forked copy of Base mainnet. Then it shows you the transactions.
If it's one of the 207 already recorded, the answer is instant.
If it isn't, Sidik forks the chain and executes it while you watch.
Under half a minute. A real fork, and real transactions.
None of them broadcast, and the page says so rather than linking to an explorer that would be empty.
Across 207 addresses and 1,843 fork transactions, here is what it found.
203 of the 206 checkable addresses publish verified source code.
So do 59 of the 60 Sidik caught. Checking that a contract is verified separates almost nothing.
25 tokens have a privileged address that can still stop you selling.
Nine of them pass every other probe. USDC and DEGEN are on that list.
Sidik pulled each switch on a fork and made the identical sell again. It proves the capability, not the intent.
And where the scanners beat us, we publish that too.
On buy tax, GoPlus matched the executed figure on 185 out of 185.
207 addresses. Every verdict reproducible from a fork you run yourself.
